entrypoints.description: Shared source application boundary archives immutable source-derived versions without promoting claims.
Registers source/document identity and locator/content-verification state before optional raw-file materialization, reusing the same evidence.documents identity.

extension_seams: Add SourcePlugin/transport adapters behind the existing source/archive ports.
Add source discovery/watchlist behavior without changing logical document identity semantics.
Add later materialization workers that enrich locator/content-verified documents with raw bytes only after identity/content verification.

guards.description: Archive regression tests preserve content-addressed/source-version behavior.
Locator lifecycle tests prevent document-version persistence from being mistaken for raw-byte materialization and keep later raw materialization explicit/version-scoped.
Materialized-source tests require truthful provenance when local bytes are a readable representation of an upstream PDF rather than the raw PDF itself.

non_goals: Evidence claim grounding or Fact/Judgment promotion.
Treating retrieval host, a .pdf suffix, or locator existence as claim authority/content proof.
Requiring byte-identical PDF materialization before claim-relevant content that was actually read can be preserved for Evidence.
purpose: Own source identity and preservation across locator_verified, content_verified and materialized states so readable/verifiable source information is not lost or blocked by transport friction. Preserved readable representations may create document versions without claiming raw-source materialization; later verified raw bytes enrich the same logical document explicitly.
revisit_when: Replace only if a stronger source-version authority preserves one logical document identity across locator/content/raw states, truthful representation provenance, immutable materialized bytes and contradiction-aware enrichment.
title: Source identity, preservation and deferred materialization
